<!-- overview:start -->

## Overview

Verify published npm tarballs against release assets, then stage only missing files and publish the draft with HoverKraft release/update using GITHUB_TOKEN.

<!-- overview:end -->
<!-- inputs:start -->

## Inputs

| **Input**                  | **Description**                                                                                                                                        | **Required** | **Default** |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------ | ----------- |
| **`tag`**                  | Committed release tag.                                                                                                                                 | **true**     | -           |
| **`package-tarball-path`** | Local tarball path returned by package/publish, or a glob matching downloaded workspace tarballs. Use the original npm bytes restored during recovery. | **true**     | -           |
| **`asset-name`**           | Plain .tgz filename for a single tarball. Leave empty to preserve matched tarball filenames.                                                           | **false**    | -           |

<!-- inputs:end -->

## Usage

```yaml
- uses: hoverkraft-tech/ci-github-nodejs/actions/release/finalize@fbd3522b68c55a6314aadbededaa487825ba9b35 # 3.0.0
  with:
    # Committed release tag.
    # This input is required.
    tag: ""

    # Local tarball path returned by package/publish, or a glob matching downloaded workspace tarballs. Use the original npm bytes restored during recovery.
    # This input is required.
    package-tarball-path: ""

    # Plain .tgz filename for a single tarball. Leave empty to preserve matched tarball filenames.
    asset-name: ""
```
